senses.definition: that which is responsible for one's thoughts, feelings, and conscious brain functions; the seat of the faculty of reason
examples: I couldn't get his words out of my head

senses.definition: the immaterial part of a person; the actuating cause of an individual life
relating to or used in or engaged in the practice of psychiatry
a physician who specializes in psychiatry
mental or emotional as opposed to physical in nature
of or relating to or determined by psychology

examples: war that caught them in its toils either psychologically or physically
the event was very damaging to the child psychologically
